source.n: CONVENIO PARA LA TRANSMISION DE VALIJAS DIPLOMATICAS (GRAN BRETAÑA, 1946)

target.n: CONVENIO PARA EL CANJE DE PERIODICOS OFICIALES Y DOCUMENTOS PARLAMENTARIOS (ESTADOS UNIDOS DE AMERICA, 1937)

texts.153258: CANJE DE NOTAS Que por medio de notas cambiadas en la ciudad de Londres, Inglaterra, el día veintisiete de septiembre de mil novecientos cuarenta y seis, entre el Excelentísimo Señor Ernest Bevin, Principal Secretario de Su Majestad para el Despacho de Asuntos Exteriores, y el señor Federico Jiménez O'Farril, Embajador Extraordinario y Plenipotenciario de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos ante el Gobierno de Su Majestad Británica, quedó constituído un Convenio para la transmisión de Valijas Diplomáticas entre ambos países, siendo el texto y la forma de dichas notas, los siguientes:
texts.153259: SECCIÓN GRAN BRETAÑA **"FOREIGN OFFICE, S. W. 1.** 27th september 1946. No. T 18219/2071/373. Your Excellency, I have the honour to propose to Your Excellency an agreement between His Majesty's Government in the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland and the Mexican Government for the transmission of diplomatic correspondence between the British Foreign Office and His Majesty's Embassy in Mexico City, on the one hand, and between the Mexican Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores and the Mexican Embassy in London, on the other, in the following terms:
texts.153262: 3.- There shall be no charge in the acceptance and conveyance of these diplomatic bags, which shall enjoy all the immunities customarily granted by the British and Mexican authorities respectively to official mails, and shall be involable.
texts.157655: CANJE DE NOTAS Que por notas cambiadas con fechas nueve y veinticuatro de septiembre de mil novecientos treinta y siete, respectivamente, entre la Embajada de los Estados Unidos de América en México y la Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos, quedó concertado entre los dos países, un Convenio para el canje de periódicos oficiales y documentos parlamentarios, siendo los textos de las mencionadas notas los siguientes:
texts.157656: SECCIÓN ESTADOS UNIDOS DE NORTEAMERICA "Embassy of the United States of America. México, september 9, 1937.- N° 2408. Excellency: I have the honor to refer to Your Excellency's note N° 39838 of august 31, 1937, informing me that the Mexican Government is prepared to enter into an agreement with the American Government providing for an exchange of official journals and parliamentary documents. It appears that a draft of this proposed agreement has already been approved by our respective Gobernments (sic) which have agreed that it shall take the form of an exchange o notes incorporationg the text. My Government is, therefore, prepared to give inmmediate effect to the following agreement as soon as a cor (sic) responding (sic) note may be received from Your Excellency: "There shall be an immediate exchange of official journals and parliamentary documents between the United States of America and the United Mexican States, which shall be conducted in accordance with the following provisions:
